title: ArchiSteamFarm Monitor (Community)
description: Unofficial community integration for monitoring ArchiSteamFarm (ASF) bots. NOT supported by ASF developers.

asf_host.name: ASF Host
asf_host.description: IP address or hostname where ArchiSteamFarm is running

asf_port.name: ASF IPC Port
asf_port.description: IPC port that ArchiSteamFarm is listening on

asf_password.name: ASF Password
asf_password.description: IPC/Web password for ArchiSteamFarm (leave empty if not configured)

scan_interval.name: Scan interval
scan_interval.description: How frequently to update ASF data (in seconds)
